summary: The retained client-mode transport decision records a historical route with accepted1/results0 despite an observed engine movement: forwarding counters did not supply the missing native admission result. The retained decision requires binding plugin, batch sequence, client correlation, command index and authoritative target, registering pending work before forwarding, and rejecting wrong owners, late/duplicate reports and disconnect/timeout as acceptance. Protected CoordinatorClient and gateway source carry admission and later dispatch on distinct paths. Preserve unknown outcomes rather than auto-retrying or synthesizing CommandAck.results. The historical native proof and FSBar receiver join have their own scope; this audit executes no joined runtime.
title: Correlate admission results without turning forwarding into effects
